title: Write the Design section of CLAUDE.md
body: The few design decisions with an outsized effect on performance and on how the rest of the code gets written: the libnail/nail boundary, the machine-first DP layer, abstraction only after the second implementation, and error flow from leaf to main. Three or four paragraphs in CLAUDE.md. Jack decides: whether new features default to nail, whether HMMER is the tiebreaker on numerics, whether libnail keeps anyhow or grows typed errors, whether a single-impl trait is banned. A draft is in the notes.
